requirement: Optimize photorealistic panning and repeat heavy demo profiling without changing power settings.
method: Release; resident tiles; eight-second warmup; ten-second scene-driven phases; full 0.8–1.2s target-PID RealityKit Metal-layer samples; final captures without CPU sampling.
distinctMovementMethod: Scene callbacks sample the actually committed Tiles3DEntity.panOffset, not queued input.
limitations: No physical iPhone or iPad performance claim; simulator counters are diagnostics.
Per-second layer samples do not establish every individual frame deadline.
Continuous geographic photo overlays fail closed while the current surface snapshot is pending.
Simulator photorealistic panning is slower than native macOS; no hardware60fps claim follows from it.
The final iPad simulator run logged one budgetExceeded wall-coverage failure for4110cuts; the complete rim was hidden by the existing fail-closed policy. This remains unresolved.
captureVersions: Path/image and simulator raster runs precede the final photo-only wall partition and LOD coalescing changes. The polygon control was repeated on the final binary. Every capture retains its exact executable hash.

boundedSameFrameWall.reason: Rendered pan minimum58.04fps and distinct updates54–64/s; rejected in favor of background preparation.

validation.review: No remaining actionable findings after staged-presentation, upload-failure and coalescing review.

preparationBenchmarks.status: Opt-in Release diagnostics, separate from rendered captures.
